title: A game master teleports within the Commons, the others see it, and a point it adds works at once
notes: 6.06: two wizards enter the Commons as two-wizards.json has them and the main account is a game master. It walks away, types .tele Start
and snaps to the Start fountain with no loading screen while the companion sees it pop there; .gps prints its place beside the minimap;
after another walk .tele add keeps the spot, which .tele takes it back to at once, with no reload, before .tele del removes it.
server_log_allowed: character_create_school holds no school, so no wizard can be created until it does
realmlist holds no realm, so no player can be sent to a gameserver until one is added

steps.name: make the main account a game master
steps.pattern: Security level of \S+ set to 2

steps.name: the client brings its renderer up
steps.pattern: About to initialize graphical client\.

steps.name: the login window is on the screen
log in
the server accepts the password
steps.pattern: authenticated as {user} \(id \d+\)

steps.name: the client is admitted
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the character selection scene loads
steps.pattern: WizardCharacterSelect: The scene has been loaded successfully\.

steps.name: the character selection screen is on the screen
press play

until.pattern: sent account \d+ with wizard (\d+) to realm

steps.name: the game server spends the key
steps.pattern: Session \d+ attached: account \d+ with wizard (\d+)

steps.name: the game server puts the wizard in the Commons
steps.pattern: put wizard {wizard_guid} in WizardCity/WC_Hub instance \d+ at .* with mobile id (\d+),

steps.name: the client loads the zone and the wizard stands in it
steps.pattern: loaded (\S+), and wizard {wizard_guid} stands in the world

steps.name: the main wizard backs away from the start
the main wizard alone
the client brings its renderer up (companion)
steps.pattern: About to initialize graphical client\.

steps.name: the login window is on the screen (companion)
log in (companion)
the server accepts the password (companion)
steps.pattern: authenticated as {companion_user} \(id \d+\)

steps.name: the client is admitted (companion)
steps.pattern: The LoginServer has admitted the user

steps.name: the character selection scene loads (companion)
steps.pattern: WizardCharacterSelect: The scene has been loaded successfully\.

steps.name: the character selection screen is on the screen (companion)
press play (companion)

until.pattern: sent account \d+ with wizard (\d+) to realm

steps.name: the game server spends the key (companion)
steps.pattern: Session \d+ attached: account \d+ with wizard (\d+)

steps.name: the game server puts the wizard in the Commons (companion)
steps.pattern: put wizard {companion_wizard_guid} in WizardCity/WC_Hub instance \d+ at .* with mobile id (\d+),

steps.name: the two wizards are shown to each other
steps.pattern: Session \d+'s wizard {companion_wizard_guid} and the (\d+) wizard\(s\) already in instance \d+ were shown to each other

steps.name: the client loads the zone and the wizard stands in it (companion)
steps.pattern: loaded (\S+), and wizard {companion_wizard_guid} stands in the world

steps.name: the game master walks away from the start
the companion sees the game master before the teleport
open the chat line to type .tele Start
take out the slash the key writes before .tele Start
type .tele Start
send .tele Start
the game master snaps to the Start fountain, shown to the companion
steps.pattern: Session \d+'s wizard {wizard_guid} was teleported within WizardCity/WC_Hub to \((\S+, \S+, \S+)\) facing \S+, shown to (\d+) other wizard\(s\)

steps.name: the game master at the fountain with no loading screen
the companion sees the game master pop to the fountain
open the chat line to type .gps
take out the slash the key writes before .gps
type .gps
send .gps
the game master's .gps runs
steps.pattern: account \d+ with wizard {wizard_guid} ran gps, which worked

steps.name: the game master reads its coordinates beside the minimap
the game master walks to a new spot
open the chat line to type .tele add
take out the slash the key writes before .tele add
type .tele add
send .tele add
the game master's point is added
steps.pattern: account \d+ with wizard {wizard_guid} ran tele add Driver Spot, which worked

steps.name: open the chat line to type .tele Start again
take out the slash the key writes before .tele Start again
type .tele Start again
send .tele Start again
the game master is back at the fountain
steps.pattern: Session \d+'s wizard {wizard_guid} was teleported within WizardCity/WC_Hub to \((\S+, \S+, \S+)\) facing \S+, shown to (\d+) other wizard\(s\)

steps.name: open the chat line to type .tele Driver Spot
take out the slash the key writes before .tele Driver Spot
type .tele Driver Spot
send .tele Driver Spot
the new point works at once
steps.pattern: account \d+ with wizard {wizard_guid} ran tele Driver Spot, which worked

steps.name: the game master at its new point
the companion sees the game master at the new point
open the chat line to type .tele del
take out the slash the key writes before .tele del
type .tele del
send .tele del
the point is removed
steps.pattern: account \d+ with wizard {wizard_guid} ran tele del Driver Spot, which worked
